items.fixed_for: same run including same-map rebuild and presentation replay
normal_contract: filter by currently committed admission prerequisites first
draw once then construct selected existing instance
node transitions use selected fixed graph
validate unique registered IDs, content hash and total integer weight <= 2147483647; retain order for cumulative intervals

items.name: fixed repeat compiled to DAG
items.level: NEW_AUTHORING_COMPILER; generic finite graph runtime unchanged
items.player: 預先編排打三輪同樣房間，每輪機關重新開始，最後一輪才結算
input: explicit visit-local or run-wide flag scope
items.implemented_analysis_helper: build_authoring.py compile_repeat supports only one-node visit-local subset; not deployed
lowering: visit i becomes unique authored node i
rename every signal producer and all requiredFlags/opensWithFlag/disabledByFlag references with visit namespace
keep waveId local to each new node; world actor ID remains allocator-owned
every nonfinal InteractZ becomes NextNode(i+1), final remains Result
constraints: expanded nodes <=256 and flags <=64, names <=64 chars
no hidden carried producers; reject undeclared cross-visit dependencies
no alternative exits or drops in this bounded helper
existing fixed two-map/mainline-source-preserving adapter is not automatically compatible
items.reward_policy: Examples explicitly set defeatExperience=0 and clearExperience=0, contain no drops or completionExperience. End reward remains existing selected adapter policy; only one Result endpoint exists. A per-kill or per-room reward design must count expanded occurrences explicitly.
items.owner_policy: Repeated nodes can rebuild same map and actor; not same-encounter waves. Cross-node HP/cooldown preservation is separately opt-in on supported story adapter. Use existing reinforcement arrays instead when the intended experience is uninterrupted same-room combat.

items.name: consume item to open or select route
items.level: NEW_TRANSACTIONAL_GAMEPLAY_ADAPTER; reuse existing inventory storage and publication
items.player: 真的扣掉鑰匙後才開門，背包和關卡狀態一致
normal_contract: use existing legitimate checkpoint interaction and current position/liveness checks
read and consume authoritative committed inventory in existing transaction boundary
record successful business receipt for the chosen gate operation
publish bag/shortcut deltas using existing asset sync
project successful receipt into current instance gate state
do not consume on mere UI preview, cinematic completion or polling
items.scope_limit: Current schema has no item predicate or consume action. Inventing free-form Client flag or new wire is unnecessary. Exact cross-store coupling must be implemented in existing service transaction API, not asserted as already present.

existing_service_mapping.pattern: SqliteTownTradeStore transaction and postcommit assets receipt; quest-completion consumption already shares a transaction with progress
existing_service_mapping.not_existing: no generic consume-to-open operation on current trade interface; scroll/shop APIs cannot be repurposed as gate success

proposed_operation.name: ConsumeScenarioGateAuthorized (proposal only)
proposed_operation.transaction: within existing SQLite owner: validate lease and accepted operation, read count, subtract exact quantity, store gate-operation receipt in same transaction, return committed slot deltas and receipt
proposed_operation.publication: only committed receipt can set corresponding instance flag/open state; repeat refresh reads prior receipt and returns current state without another debit
proposed_operation.failure: no receipt and no gate state change when count/admission fails; do not reopen by Client callback
proposed_operation.save_scope: per-run receipt can survive presentation rebuild; cross-login continuation requires explicit run resume policy before promising persistence
